productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
The laughs keep coming as George and Harold unleash even bigger pranks—and even bigger problems—in this next batch of Captain Underpants adventures. When a new science teacher turns a harmless joke into a town-wide name-changing disaster, the boys learn that teasing can have truly colossal consequences. Things only get wilder when an over-the-top homeroom teacher becomes a full-blown villain with robots and a plan for domination, forcing Captain Underpants to step in once again. And when a prank goes too far with the school brainiac, a nose-sneezing accident creates the unforgettable Bionic Booger Boy, threatening to slime everything in sight.

**_Yoto Says: These Captain Underpants stories go bigger and weirder in the best way, mixing nonstop laughs with the familiar rhythm that makes the series so fun._**

The laughs keep coming as George and Harold unleash even bigger pranks—and even bigger problems—in this next batch of Captain Underpants adventures. When a new science teacher turns a harmless joke into a town-wide name-changing disaster, the boys learn that teasing can have truly colossal consequences. Things only get wilder when an over-the-top homeroom teacher becomes a full-blown villain with robots and a plan for domination, forcing Captain Underpants to step in once again. And when a prank goes too far with the school brainiac, a nose-sneezing accident creates the unforgettable Bionic Booger Boy, threatening to slime everything in sight.  
  
  
  
  
Packed with Dav Pilkey’s trademark humor, outrageous villains, and Sound-O-Rama fun, this pack delivers nonstop silliness and superhero chaos that fans expect from the series.  
  
  
  
  
This pack includes:  
  
Captain Underpants #4: Captain Underpants and the Perilous Plot of Professor Poopypants

The laughs keep coming as George and Harold unleash even bigger pranks—and even bigger problems—in this next batch of Captain Underpants adventures. When a new science teacher turns a harmless joke into a town-wide name-changing disaster, the boys learn that teasing can have truly colossal consequences. Things only get wilder when an over-the-top homeroom teacher becomes a full-blown villain with robots and a plan for domination, forcing Captain Underpants to step in once again. And when a prank goes too far with the school brainiac, a nose-sneezing accident creates the unforgettable Bionic Booger Boy, threatening to slime everything in sight.


Packed with Dav Pilkey’s trademark humor, outrageous villains, and Sound-O-Rama fun, this pack delivers nonstop silliness and superhero chaos that fans expect from the series.


This pack includes:

Captain Underpants #4: Captain Underpants and the Perilous Plot of Professor Poopypants  

Captain Underpants #5: Captain Underpants and the Wrath of the Wicked Wedgie Woman  

Captain Underpants #6: Captain Underpants and the Big, Bad Battle of the Bionic Booger Boy, Part 1: The Night of the Nasty Nostril Nuggets
